title: On the Inactive tab, searching not tracked lists only inactive untracked parts
custom_preconds:
• One inactive untracked part and one active untracked part at the location.
  • Parts > Inventory.
custom_steps:
1. Click the Inactive tab.
  2. Search "not tracked".
  3. Click the Active tab (search kept).
custom_expected:
Step 2:

  • Only the inactive untracked part is listed; the active untracked part is not.
  • If there are no inactive untracked parts, the filtered empty state shows.

Step 3:

  • Only active untracked parts are listed.
